author: w387
exact_statement: The nested finite-cylinder event A_n(v) of a simple centered 2n-step path shortest inside the induced l1 box B_n(v) has intersection equal to existence of a full-lattice bigeodesic through v.
assumptions: both indexed arms have n steps
all levels along a consistent branch
proof_or_counterexample: Central restriction preserves confined minimality. Finite-degree diagonal compactness gives a simple bi-infinite branch. Every fixed finite competitor fits into a sufficiently large branch box, establishing full global minimality.
remaining_gap: No estimate of P(A_n)->0. A single finite-level restricted geodesic is not globally certified.

author: w387
exact_statement: For nondegenerate iid finite nonnegative weights on Z^2, every prescribed deterministic infinite simple path fails to be a geodesic ray almost surely; the same holds for a countable prescribed family or an independently sampled path.
assumptions: nondegenerate law permits finite a<b with positive low and high masses
proof_or_counterexample: Infinitely many turns supply independent disjoint high-original/low-alternate square trials. A finite-turn tail is straight and supplies independent disjoint longer detour trials with m(b-a)>2a. Every success makes a segment strictly cheaper, so the survival product tends to0. Countable union or independent-path conditioning finishes.
remaining_gap: Not uniform over the uncountable family of paths selected by the environment.

author: w387
exact_statement: For the Uniform[1,2] square-corner geodesic in full-lattice iid FPP, a fixed two-edge route's high-low shortcut pattern has probability1/256, while the same pattern on the selected minimizing route has probability0.
assumptions: opposite corners of one unit square
proof_or_counterexample: Every competing non-square path has even length at least4 and cost at least4; the selected square minimum costs less than4 almost surely. The high selected/low other pattern would make the other route strictly cheaper. The four independent quarter-mass conditions for a fixed route multiply to1/256.
remaining_gap: Inference counterexample only; it does not show a bigeodesic exists.

author: w387
exact_statement: For a prescribed simple N-edge path, P(path geodesic)<=(1-eta)^ceil(floor(N/L)/D), with L>=2,L(b-a)>2a, eta=p^L q^(L+2), R=2(L+1),D=1+2R(R+1). Subexponential deterministic prefix dictionaries have vanishing geodesic-existence probability.
assumptions: path and dictionary geometry deterministic before weights
proof_or_counterexample: Trial supports fit in radius L+1 of distinct block starts. Overlap removes at most D starts. Greedy choice leaves the stated number of disjoint trials, each with success probability at leasteta. The resulting product is valid. A finite dictionary uses a union bound without independence between paths.
remaining_gap: The entire weight-selected candidate family has no proved low-entropy cover. Parent target not solved.

author: w387
exact_statement: The closing union estimate requires log|P_N|-[-log(1-eta)]ceil(floor(N/L)/D)->-infinity; limsup log|P_N|/N<c is sufficient. Merely log|P_N|<cN pointwise need not imply vanishing.
assumptions: using the L4 bound as the only dictionary estimate
the displayed margin is a proposed sufficient inference, not an established FPP dictionary
proof_or_counterexample: 2^(N-1) disjoint events each of probability2^-N have union probability1/2 while their log cardinality is strictly less thanN log2. A fixed logarithmic deficit does not force union decay.
independent_reviewer: w389 requested for the refinement; no new theorem promotion
remaining_gap: No covering dictionary or valid closing resampling law supplied.

author: w387
scope: Constant-law counterexample to the unqualified iid title only
exact_statement: For iid unit weights on nearest-neighbor Z^2, every horizontal and vertical coordinate line is a bigeodesic.
reproduction: A coordinate-line segment has ||x-y||_1 unit-weight edges. Every competitor needs at least that many nearest-neighbor steps, so its cost is at least this value. Apply to every finite segment of the line.
hardest_claim_rederived: The lower bound compares against all lattice competitors, including arbitrarily large detours.
remaining_gap: No gap in the counterexample; the atomless parent conjecture is unaffected. The route precommit has no quantitative annular obstruction yet.
